{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"0000000000000DYG8349E4Q1CF","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram @ -128,-64 flow=down box=256x128 grid=384x192
group host "echo-host" {
  node EchoHost "EchoHost" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/db-host/echo-host.ts"
  node SpaceState "SpaceStateManager" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/db-host/space-state-manager.ts"
  node DbRoot "DatabaseRoot" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/db-host/database-root.ts"
  node Scheduler "IndexScheduler" below DataSource ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/db-host/index-scheduler.ts"
  node DataSource "AutomergeSource" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/db-host/automerge-data-source.ts"
}
group services "RPC services" {
  node DataService "DataService" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/db-host/data-service.ts"
  node DocsSync "DocsSynchronizer" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/db-host/documents-synchronizer.ts"
  node QueryService "QueryService" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/db-host/query-service.ts"
  node Executor "QueryExecutor" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/query/query-executor.ts"
  node Planner "QueryPlanner" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/query/query-planner.ts"
}
group automerge "Automerge" {
  node AmHost "AutomergeHost" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/automerge/automerge-host.ts"
  node CollSync "CollectionSync" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/automerge/collection-synchronizer.ts"
  node Network "NetworkAdapter" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/automerge/echo-network-adapter.ts"
  node Storage "SqliteStorage" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/automerge/sqlite-storage-adapter.ts"
}
edge EchoHost -> DataService
edge EchoHost -> QueryService
edge EchoHost -> SpaceState "spaces"
edge EchoHost -> Scheduler
edge EchoHost -> DataSource
edge EchoHost -> AmHost "docs"
edge DataService -> DocsSync "subscribe"
edge DataService -> SpaceState
edge DocsSync -> AmHost
edge QueryService -> Executor "run"
edge Executor -> Planner "plan"
edge SpaceState -> DbRoot
edge DataSource -> AmHost "changes"
edge AmHost -> CollSync
edge AmHost -> Network "replicate"
edge AmHost -> Storage "persist"
"},"objects":[
